full_page.content:
1937, October
FATHER SOLANUS NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 217 Cont.
Oct. 5th Raymond Chatel - 48 - badly burned last Sunday - gas Explos'n
Oct. 6 11 a.m. Mrs. Helen (Murphy) King non C. - pneumonia after serious operation - confinement - at 3 P.M. became better - at 7 P.M. seems out of danger.
Mary M. Defer - 50 - broken leg 3 weeks ago .... speedy recovery
Page 218
Oct. 6 Alice Carskodon - 22 - Epyl. for 12 yrs ... doctoring in vain Tansey .... Casey - irreverence .. Cornelius Boes - 35 - heart - raised Cath. Married Convert - became sick .... taken to healer Mrs .... lost his faith with convert wife -
Page 219 to 240
There are just names and addresses for help wanted, etc.
1943, March
Page 24 1
March Mary E. Giroralt - 69 - bad cough and wasting away
Mrs. Helen Sebert - 34 - Mother of two little girls, drinking - wants to go to "san. for treatment ... I find she has been away from confession for years - husband a congregationelist - good honest Christian ... am sending her out to confession and, advising her to enroll perp'ly ..... and go more frequently to sacram ..... and him to find out earnestly as to where ... stands in relation to the mother church.
Rest of book - 58 pages - There are just names and addresses for help wanted, etc.
END OF NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
